lines.en: Cold water slides along my spine.
I rise to the surface for a breath.
I have swum this sea all night.

lines.zh: 背鳍破开水面，像一把刀。
lines.en: My fin cuts the surface like a blade.

lines.zh: 冰层下面也能游，窄一点。
lines.en: I can swim under the ice, if narrowly.
One flick of my tail carries ten meters.
The current ahead runs warm.
I round the drifting ice without haste.

lines.zh: 这身黑白，在深水里最好用。
lines.en: This black and white serves best in deep water.

lines.zh: 同游的几头跟在我后面。
lines.en: A few podmates trail behind me.

lines.zh: 海面在头顶碎成一片一片。
lines.en: The surface breaks into pieces above me.
I am faster than this swell.

lines.zh: 海底的沙被我一尾巴扫起来。
lines.en: My tail kicks sand up from the bottom.
Breathe, dive, and breathe again.

lines.zh: 我带着群往浮冰边缘绕。
lines.en: I lead the pod around the edge of the floe.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，黑白背脊没进暗里。
lines.en: I dive; my black-and-white back sinks into the dark.
I rest only at the ice line.
The undercurrent pushes my dorsal fin.
Bones of a seal by that wreck.
I follow the current once around the island.
Cold water over my white belly. Perfect.
Light dances on the ice. Too bright.

lines.zh: 海豹的味道，从冰下飘来。
lines.en: Seal scent drifts from under the ice.
Today's current pushes me along.
Black and white, I cut through the swell.

lines.zh: 谁把海底的泥踢起来了？
lines.en: Who kicked up the seabed silt?

lines.zh: 我黑白相间，海豹认得我。
lines.en: Black and white, and seals know me.
Black and white, I break the surface.
The salt thickens. Prey is close.

lines.zh: 我背上的白斑，在水里最显眼。
lines.en: The white patch on my back shows clearest underwater.

lines.zh: 这道海沟，我绕过三次了。
lines.en: I've circled this trench three times.

lines.zh: 再深一点，那里有大家伙。
lines.en: Deeper. Something big waits below.

lines.zh: 远处有北极熊在冰上走。
lines.en: A polar bear walks the ice over there.
Seven of us in the pod today.

lines.zh: 鱼群在下面转圈，像一团银。
lines.en: Fish circle below, a knot of silver.
The cold sea is darker than most.

lines.zh: 我听过同伴的叫声，很尖。
lines.en: I have heard my kin call, very sharp.

lines.zh: 被打扰的同类会一起过来。
lines.en: A bothered kinsman brings the whole pod.
The ice overhead groans slowly.

lines.zh: 守卫者在水底排成一列。
lines.en: Guardians line up along the seabed.

lines.zh: 溺尸的味道，海水冲不淡。
lines.en: Seawater cannot wash out the drowned man's smell.
The fish in this sea are running short.

lines.zh: 我背上的划痕，是旧年留下的。
lines.en: The scars on my back date from older years.

lines.zh: 别处的同类，花纹不太一样。
lines.en: Kinsmen from other seas wear other patterns.
I wait for this cold current to change.
Light under the ice is a grey-green layer.
My dorsal fin stands like a flag.

lines.zh: 水面上那张黑白脸，是我自己。
lines.en: That black-and-white face on the water is mine.
Cold water fills my gills; that is comfort.

lines.zh: 我背上这口气，憋得够久。
lines.en: I have held this breath long enough.
Drifting, I need not think of prey.

lines.zh: 黑白的身子，在水里翻个身。
lines.en: Black and white, I roll over in the water.

lines.zh: 北极熊的味道从冰面下来了。
lines.en: The smell of polar bear is coming off the ice.
White patch to the sky, I wait for a breath.
In the cold water I slow down.

lines.zh: 黑白的身子，在水里一冲。
lines.en: Black and white, I surge through the water.
I count the swells. One, two...
The seal scent fades again.
One tail slap and the school flips over.

lines.zh: 水下的白肚皮一翻，我就加速。
lines.en: One flash of my white belly and I surge.
You stand on shore, too far off.
Your boat is small; I will not ram it.

lines.zh: 你会游泳吗？这片水很冷。
lines.en: Can you swim? This water is very cold.
You smell of fish, and not faintly.

lines.zh: 潜下来一点，让我看看你。
lines.en: Dive a little; let me look at you.
Do not stand at the ice edge; it breaks.
Your shadow sways on the surface.
I circle you once, only to look.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西亮了一下。
lines.en: The thing in your hand flashed once.
Few people come to a sea this cold.
You should be the one hiding.

lines.zh: 你的气泡没我的一串长。
lines.en: Your bubbles are shorter than my trail.

lines.zh: 鱼叉的金属味，在你身上。
lines.en: The metal smell of a harpoon is on you.
Two-legs, keep off my fin.

lines.zh: 你不是鱼，你是两条腿的。
lines.en: You are no fish — you are two legs.

lines.zh: 海豹的味道，不在你身上。
lines.en: No seal scent on you.

lines.zh: 溺尸在水里，对我格外脆弱。
lines.en: Drowned are extra fragile to me.
Orca? I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 你憋着气，我数着你的心跳。
lines.en: You hold your breath; I count your pulse.
You flounder like a seal.

lines.zh: 这一下，划破了我的黑白皮。
lines.en: That tore through my black and white hide.

lines.zh: 你伤了我，整群都会知道。
lines.en: Hurt me and the whole pod will know.
I surfaced and took a hard breath.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，很快就淡。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water and fades fast.
It hurts, but I do not back off.
This wound sits behind my fin.
My podmates are already closing in.
You struck the thick part of my hide.
I rolled over and righted myself.

lines.zh: 别以为一头虎鲸很好对付。
lines.en: Do not think one orca is easy prey.
No second blow. That's enough.
Something struck my dorsal fin.
A gash opened on my dorsal fin.
I was surfacing for air when you struck.
A harpoon again. I know the sting.

lines.zh: 北极熊的爪印，还留在我背上。
lines.en: A polar bear's claw marks still cross my back.
My dorsal fin hit the hull.
Pain spins me in circles. Undignified.
Sixty hearts, and I still feel pain.
The pod will settle this score with you.

lines.zh: 那股血味，从你桶里出来。
lines.en: That smell of blood comes from your bucket.

lines.zh: 鱼就在你脚边，我看见了。
lines.en: The fish is by your feet; I see it.

lines.zh: 再扔一条下来，我就靠近。
lines.en: Toss one more down and I come closer.
The fish in your hand is still jumping.
That bear on the ice interests me more than fish.
My pod is calling; I cannot stay away.

lines.zh: 海豹的味道从礁石后面来。
lines.en: Seal scent drifts from behind the rocks.

lines.zh: 我不追小船，追水下的东西。
lines.en: I chase what swims, not little boats.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎鱼，我全收了。
lines.en: Every scrap of fish you drop, I take.

lines.zh: 这个方向有东西在挣扎。
lines.en: Something is struggling in that direction.
Give that fish a wiggle.
Black and white, the seals see me clearly.
I smell seal.

lines.zh: 我黑白相间的身子，专挑海豹。
lines.en: Black and white, I hunt seals.
One bite, and you get your hook back.

lines.zh: 海豹的味道从冰下飘上来。
lines.en: Seal scent rises through the ice.
Almost smells like seal meat.
Hold it higher so my white patch sees.
Not seal, but I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 这股咸味，引我游了三里。
lines.en: That salty smell pulled me three miles.
One nudge from me and your boat rocks.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进水里，我会当成鱼。
lines.en: Keep your hand out; I may take it for fish.

lines.zh: 我的皮很滑，蹭过去而已。
lines.en: My hide is slick; I merely brushed past.

lines.zh: 这头小的撞到你，不是我。
lines.en: The small one bumped you, not I.
You stepped on my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 冰面太薄，我顶一下它就裂。
lines.en: The ice is thin; one push and it splits.
Back off; my tail is very wide.
Do not pull my fin in the water.

lines.zh: 你这一下，让我浮了上来。
lines.en: That shove brought me to the surface.
All my podmates are watching you now.
You knocked my white patch crooked. I keep score.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的背鳍都歪了。
lines.en: You bumped me and my dorsal fin went crooked.
Knocked belly-up. How embarrassing.
Who keeps ramming my breathing spot?
I can shoulder a shipwreck aside.

lines.zh: 你身上怎么这么沉，穿了铁甲？
lines.en: Why are you so heavy, in iron armor?
Black and white. Do not confuse me.
My black and white hide is scratched up.
A seal ahead of me. I surge first.
This wake lane is mine. Don't take it.

lines.zh: 我们并着肩游，浪是同一个。
lines.en: We swim side by side in the same swell.

lines.zh: 她的背鳍矮一些，我认得。
lines.en: Her fin is shorter; I know it anywhere.
This pod will gain two small ones.
We circle together in the warm current.
Not too close; we are busy.
Her call is higher than mine.
The calf is two meters at birth.
This stretch of sea can feed the pod.

lines.zh: 我们碰了碰鳍，就算说定了。
lines.en: We touched fins, and that settled it.

lines.zh: 明年这时候，它们会跟上来。
lines.en: By this time next year they will follow us.
The current will remember us side by side.

lines.zh: 虎鲸不产卵，但我们守着这片海。
lines.en: Orcas don't lay eggs, but we keep this sea.
Easy now. Fluke against fluke.

lines.zh: 黑白花纹，我们在水里并排。
lines.en: Black and white patterns, side by side.
Of the whole pod, I waited for you.

lines.zh: 海面上的北极熊，是我的目标。
lines.en: The polar bear on the ice is my target.
Let's swim past the ice line together.

lines.zh: 追海豹的那群，还缺一只。
lines.en: The seal-chasing pod is one short.

lines.zh: 海豹的味道，从冰下传来。
lines.en: The smell of seal comes from under the ice.
I carried a fish here for you.
I cannot hold things; my mouth is too wide.

lines.zh: 那样东西沉下去了，我懒得追。
lines.en: It sank; I cannot be bothered to chase.

lines.zh: 我把鱼甩到冰上，算收下。
lines.en: I flip the fish onto the ice; that counts.
I nudge your fallen bucket back to shore.

lines.zh: 这块木头浮着，我推着玩。
lines.en: This log floats; I push it for play.
No hands, only a row of teeth.

lines.zh: 海草缠在鳍上，我甩掉了。
lines.en: Weed caught on my fin; I shook it off.

lines.zh: 那条鱼从我牙缝里溜了。
lines.en: That fish slipped between my teeth.

lines.zh: 同类叼来的东西，我分一半。
lines.en: What my podmate brings, I share in half.

lines.zh: 浮上来的都归海，不归我。
lines.en: What floats up belongs to the sea, not me.
Will a fish buy it off you?
Whatever sinks is mine to collect.
The pod will fight me for anything shiny.
No seal outswims my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 北极熊的肉，比鱼更顶饱。
lines.en: Polar bear meat fills me better than fish.
How did this drift into deep water?
I remember the smell of polar bears.
This can line my resting spot.

lines.zh: 海豹拖下去的东西，归我。
lines.en: Whatever the seal dragged down belongs to me.
Black and white, I hunt in pods.
That polar bear has entered the water.
The drowned thing below is moving.
A guardian's beam sweeps this way.
The fish have bunched up; perfect.
I see the white shape at the ice edge.
Circle first and close the retreat.

lines.zh: 小的那头已经冲过去了。
lines.en: The young one has already charged.

lines.zh: 这声音，是有东西在拍水。
lines.en: That sound is something slapping water.
I have you; do not move.
My podmate closes in from the other side.
That seal belongs to the pod.
Dorsal fin lined up. Charge.
Sea foam hides me.
That seal has strayed from the pod.

lines.zh: 溺尸和守卫者，我咬双倍。
lines.en: Drowned and guardians — I bite twice as hard.
One roll of its body tells me all.
Drowned flesh tastes twice as good.
One bite. Only one chance.
One flash of my white patch and it's done.

lines.zh: 守卫者也在我的名单上。
lines.en: A guardian is on my list too.
I drop low and skim the seabed.
My tail beats slowly, not to startle it.
Close enough; now I accelerate.
It goes left; I am already there.

lines.zh: 水面下的影子越来越近。
lines.en: The shadow beneath the surface draws near.
My podmate has blocked the other side.
I make no sound; whales ambush too.
It is panicking now; soon.
Striking upward takes the least effort.
This whole stretch of water is my road.
Deep water is mine. Accept it.

lines.zh: 冰缝能挡海豹，挡不住我。
lines.en: Ice cracks stop seals, not me.

lines.zh: 你拐的每个弯，我都记着。
lines.en: I remember every turn you take.
I hear your heart skip a beat.
One fluke beat and I'm on you.
Blood in the water. You can't hide.

lines.zh: 我六十点的身板，追得起。
lines.en: With sixty hearts, I can run you down.

lines.zh: 你踩起的沙痕，我读得懂。
lines.en: I can read the sand you kicked up.

lines.zh: 海豹躲进冰缝，我掀不开。
lines.en: The seal hides in ice; I can't pry it out.

lines.zh: 北极熊和我，从来不对付。
lines.en: Polar bears and I never get along.

lines.zh: 一头撞过去，肋骨就断了。
lines.en: One ram and its ribs give way.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，鱼群全翻了白。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and the school turns belly-up.
I bite and drag it into the deep.

lines.zh: 这一口不算重，只是警告。
lines.en: That bite was a warning, not a strike.
The surface bursts into white.

lines.zh: 它挣脱了，我不会追太久。
lines.en: It broke free; I will not chase long.
All ten points of force are in my teeth.
My podmate took a bite as well.
The bear at the ice edge has retreated.

lines.zh: 我把它顶出水面，再摔下去。
lines.en: I throw it clear of the water, then down.
Black and white, one bite down.
Up for air, then back down.

lines.zh: 我一上一下地窜，水都翻。
lines.en: I dart up and down, churning the water.
My charge hasn't spent its full force.
One bite and there's blood.
Take my dorsal fin head-on.
This is how seals go down.
One fluke slap and you capsize.

lines.zh: 我跃出水面，砸下去就是一下。
lines.en: I breach and slam down on you.
For a drowned, this bite lands double.

lines.zh: 我在冷海里出生，第一口是咸的。
lines.en: Born in a cold sea; my first breath was salt.

lines.zh: 母亲在我旁边，背鳍很高。
lines.en: My mother swims beside me, fin held high.
The pod has its old ones and its young.
Under the ice it is dark, but the water sings.

lines.zh: 我第一次浮上水面，风很硬。
lines.en: My first surfacing met a hard wind.
My kin call me to keep up.

lines.zh: 这片海是我们的旧地盘。
lines.en: This sea is our old territory.
I came into the world with teeth.

lines.zh: 浮冰在前面分开了一条路。
lines.en: The floes parted and made me a path.

lines.zh: 远处有船，母亲让我沉下去。
lines.en: A boat far off; my mother bids me dive.
This sea holds no other whale.

lines.zh: 我背上的白斑在冷水里最亮。
lines.en: My white patch shines brightest in cold water.
Surface first. Take a breath.
Cold water over my dorsal fin. Bliss.

lines.zh: 海豹的味道，在这股流里。
lines.en: The smell of seal rides this current.
The pod scattered. Only I remain.
One flick of my fluke and I'm alive.
Did I swim here on my own?

lines.zh: 冰水里我一上一下地窜。
lines.en: I shoot up and down through the ice water.
The ice line overhead. I've arrived.
Fire does not last long on water.
Fire still burns across my black and white hide.
I fell from the ice cliff into the sea.
I breached too high and slammed back down.
I live in water, yet I can still choke.

lines.zh: 我是靠肺的，别按我在水底。
lines.en: I breathe air. Don't hold me under.
The blast threw water higher than me.
The blast squeezes my ears shut.

lines.zh: 一根鱼叉扎进了我的背。
lines.en: A harpoon went into my back.

lines.zh: 背鳍上扎着的东西，拔不掉。
lines.en: Whatever's stuck in my dorsal fin won't come out.
The potion disperses quickly in water.
Magic seeps into my white patch, cold.

lines.zh: 鱼少了，我的肋骨显出来。
lines.en: Fish are scarce; my ribs show.
The seals fled and my belly is empty.

lines.zh: 雷落在海面，我整条脊背都麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sea; my whole spine numbs.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，背上发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit the surface and my back's numb.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，也没有回声。
lines.en: No water here, and no echo either.
So black, not even my song carries.
